tax.text: Levin supports raising the payroll tax cap for higher earners to help extend Social Security’s solvency.
tax.quote: On Social Security, Levin said he supports raising the payroll tax cap for higher earners rather than cutting benefits or increasing the retirement age.

trade.text: Levin opposes Trump's tariffs and has called for them to be lifted, saying they raise families' costs.
trade.quote: Trump's tariffs are harming consumers and small businesses, and because they are so erratic they are not helping our nation expand the manufacturing base at home.

debt.text: Levin supports raising taxes on higher earners rather than cutting Social Security benefits or increasing the retirement age.
debt.quote: On Social Security, Levin said he supports raising the payroll tax cap for higher earners rather than cutting benefits or increasing the retirement age.

housing.text: Levin frames a supply shortage as the root of the housing crisis and backs investments to increase the housing supply.
housing.quote: Our nation is nearly four million units of housing short of the need, and that supply shortage is the root cause of our affordable housing crisis.

schools.text: Levin says he has fought to make sure local public schools get the resources they need.
schools.quote: Mike has fought for our local public schools, working to make sure they receive the resources they need to hire and keep excellent teachers

safety.text: Levin says he has never supported defunding police and wants to increase police funding.
safety.quote: Mike believes we should increase funding for police in a way that helps them stay safe, do their jobs more effectively, and earn the trust of the communities they serve.

immigration.text: Levin opposed a DHS funding bill after accountability measures for ICE, including limits on deportations, were rejected.
immigration.quote: We even tried to add a ban on the deportation of American citizens , and the Republicans in Congress rejected all of it!

guns.text: Levin supports universal background checks and an assault weapons ban.
guns.quote: Mike has also worked to institute an assault weapons ban and expand Brady background checks to all gun sales, including those made over the Internet and at gun shows.

abortion.text: Levin says he will defend a woman's right to make her own reproductive choices and cosponsored a bill to codify Roe.
abortion.quote: Mike will always defend a woman's right to make her own reproductive choices.

gender.text: Levin says no one should face discrimination based on gender identity and supports the Equality Act.
gender.quote: He believes that no one should face discrimination or harassment based on their gender identity or sexual orientation, and that no one should face hostility because of their sexuality.

health.text: Levin lists strengthening the Affordable Care Act to expand access and lower costs as a priority.
health.quote: All Americans should have access to affordable, quality health care, and one of Rep. Levin's priorities is strengthening the Affordable Care Act (ACA) to expand access and lower costs.

energy.text: Levin led congressional efforts to restore canceled clean-energy grants and remove delays affecting renewable-energy projects.
energy.quote: The letter pushes Secretary Burgum to submit the required reports in a timely manner and end the procedural hurdles to clean energy development that would lower Americans’ energy bills.

voting.text: Levin backs restoring the Voting Rights Act and ensuring every eligible voter can participate.
voting.quote: make elections more transparent, and make sure every eligible voter can participate

housing.text: Kurdian said his mission includes expanding access to housing for people at all income levels.
housing.quote: expand access to housing for all income levels

energy.text: Kurdian said his mission includes reducing energy costs.
